plan.failureSummary: Cached page.ai step failed to find 'Last Name' field because the dynamic survey form loaded with different fields ('Your Name', 'Contact Email').
observedIndicators: Failure occurred during deterministic cache replay in unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js (failureInCacheReplay: true, isRetryAttempt: false).
Cached selector looked for '[data-testid=\'input-lastname\']' and 'Last Name *' label.
Failure screenshot shows the form rendered with 'Your Name *' and 'Contact Email *' instead of separate first/last name fields.
The overall objective explicitly notes that form layout and element IDs shift between loads.

remediationSteps.summary: Clear Page.AI cache and re-run automation
remediationSteps.details: Clear the Page.AI cache for tests/unstable-survey.test.ts and re-run the test to let Page.AI adapt autonomously to the current form structure.

additionalDataRequests.description: Verify if unstable-survey dynamically alters field labels/IDs on every load.
suggestedSources: Application source code or live test observations

plan.notes: The failure occurred in the generated cache replay file (.cache-lock/unstable-survey.test.ts.cache.js) where previous selectors targeted a 'Last Name' field. The failure screenshot confirms the live page currently displays 'Your Name' and 'Contact Email'. Clearing the cache will allow page.ai to autonomously handle the shifted layout.
